```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(arrow)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
```

This document creates some more focused plots for the data calculated in 01_iucn_aquax_eez_overlap.qmd and 02_iucn_aquax_rangearea.qmd.

## Read in threatened species data

```{r}
# Spp in EEZs
spp_eez_pxl_count <- read_csv(here("data/iucn_threatened_spp_eez_pxls_061626.csv"))
```

```{r}
# Spp EEZ entry/exit pixels
spp_entry_pxls <- read_rds(here("data/iucn_threatened_10pxlthres_entry_pxls_061726.rds"))
spp_exit_pxls <- read_rds(here("data/iucn_threatened_10pxlthres_exit_pxls_061726.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Species range area
area_df <- read_csv(here("data/iucn_threatened_spp_range_area_061826.csv"))
```

## EEZs

```{r}
eez <- st_read('/home/shares/usgs-cap-rangeshifts/spatial/World_EEZ_v12_20231025_gpkg/eez_v12.gpkg')

eez_simple <- eez %>% 
  dplyr::select(MRGID, GEONAME)
```


```{r}
# Get list of EEZ IDs that are not overlapping claims (i.e., POL_TYPE = 200NM)
overlap_claim_list <- eez %>% 
  filter(POL_TYPE == "200NM") %>% 
  pull(MRGID)
```

## Try out rainbow plot by IUCN status

```{r}
iucn_lookup <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nceas-range-shifts/chi_shifts/refs/heads/main/_data_raw/iucn_redlist_2026/iucn_worms_aphia_id_complete.csv")
```

```{r}
iucn_cat <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nceas-range-shifts/chi_shifts/refs/heads/main/_data_raw/iucn_redlist_2026/iucn_species_assessments.csv")
```

```{r}
# Add aphiaid to iucn_cat
iucn_cat_aphiaid <- left_join(iucn_cat, (iucn_lookup %>% dplyr::select(iucn_assessment_id, aphia_id)),
 by = c("assessment_id" = "iucn_assessment_id")) %>% 
  rename(aphiaid = aphia_id) 
```

```{r}
# Merge in iucn_cat to get group for each species
spp_eez_pxl_count_group <- left_join(spp_eez_pxl_count, iucn_cat_aphiaid)
```

```{r}
# Get count of number of EEZ by group and count of IUCN cat by group (create figure similar to bar chart)
group_eez_count <- spp_eez_pxl_count_group %>% 
  # Filter for 
  filter(!MRGID %in% overlap_claim_list) %>%
  group_by(group, aphiaid, redlist_category) %>% 
  summarize(current_eez_count = sum(n_current >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
            RCP45_2050_eez_count = sum(n_RCP45_2050 >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
            RCP45_2100_eez_count = sum(n_RCP45_2100 >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
            RCP85_2050_eez_count = sum(n_RCP85_2050 >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
            RCP85_2100_eez_count = sum(n_RCP85_2100 >= 10, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup()

group_iucncat_count <- group_eez_count %>% 
  group_by(group, redlist_category) %>% 
  summarize(redlist_count = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = group_eez_count, aes(x = current_eez_count, fill = redlist_category), alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of current EEZ counts by IUCN redlist category",
       x = "current EEZ count") +
  facet_wrap(~redlist_category) +
  theme_bw()
```



```{r}
# Assign EEZ count thresholds based on plotted density (drop not comprehensively assessed)
group_eez_count_threshold <- group_eez_count %>% 
  #filter(group != "not comprehensively assessed") %>%
  mutate(current_eez_count_cat = case_when(current_eez_count == 1 ~ "1",
                                          current_eez_count == 2 ~ "2",
                                           current_eez_count > 2 & current_eez_count <= 5 ~ "3-5",
                                           current_eez_count > 5 & current_eez_count <= 10 ~ "6-10",
                                           current_eez_count > 10 & current_eez_count <= 15 ~ "11-15",
                                           current_eez_count > 15 & current_eez_count <= 20 ~ "16-20",
                                           current_eez_count > 20 & current_eez_count <= 30 ~ "21-30",
                                           TRUE ~ "0"),
         RCP85_2050_eez_count_cat = case_when(RCP85_2050_eez_count == 1 ~ "1",
                                            RCP85_2050_eez_count == 2 ~ "2",
                                           RCP85_2050_eez_count > 2 & RCP85_2050_eez_count <= 5 ~ "3-5",
                                           RCP85_2050_eez_count > 5 & RCP85_2050_eez_count <= 10 ~ "6-10",
                                           RCP85_2050_eez_count > 10 & RCP85_2050_eez_count <= 15 ~ "11-15",
                                           RCP85_2050_eez_count > 15 & RCP85_2050_eez_count <= 20 ~ "16-20",
                                           RCP85_2050_eez_count > 20 & RCP85_2050_eez_count <= 30 ~ "21-30",
                                           TRUE ~ "0")) 
```

```{r}
cat_summary <- group_eez_count_threshold %>% 
  group_by(redlist_category, current_eez_count_cat) %>% 
  summarise(n_cat = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Get total number in each group
group_count <- group_eez_count_threshold %>% 
  group_by(redlist_category) %>% 
  summarise(n_group = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Merge in group count to get percentage
cat_summary_perc <- left_join(cat_summary, group_count) %>% 
  mutate(perc_cat = n_cat/n_group * 100)
```

```{r}
group_eez_count_threshold$current_eez_count_cat <- factor(group_eez_count_threshold$current_eez_count_cat, 
levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3-5", "6-10", "11-15", "16-20", "21-30"))

group_eez_count_threshold$RCP85_2050_eez_count_cat <- factor(group_eez_count_threshold$RCP85_2050_eez_count_cat, 
levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3-5", "6-10", "11-15", "16-20", "21-30"))

group_eez_count_threshold$redlist_category <- factor(group_eez_count_threshold$redlist_category,
levels = c("CR", "EN", "VU", "NT"))
```

```{r}
library(forcats)
# Plot a bar graph by group with fill as the EEZ count category
ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = group_eez_count_threshold, aes(y = fct_rev(redlist_category), fill = fct_rev(current_eez_count_cat)), position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(title = "Current EEZ count category by IUCN category",
       y = "",
       x = "proportion",
       fill = "EEZ count") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# Plot a bar graph by group with fill as the EEZ count category
ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = group_eez_count_threshold, aes(y = fct_rev(redlist_category), fill = fct_rev(RCP85_2050_eez_count_cat)), position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(title = "RCP 8.5 2050 EEZ count category by IUCN category",
       y = "",
       x = "proportion",
       fill = "EEZ count") +
  theme_bw()
```

## Set up dataframe so that it's easier to plot current vs future side by side for each group 
```{r}
eez_count_group_simple <- group_eez_count_threshold %>% 
  dplyr::select(redlist_category, current_eez_count_cat, RCP85_2050_eez_count_cat) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(current_eez_count_cat, RCP85_2050_eez_count_cat), names_to = "scenario", values_to = "eez_count_cat") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = str_replace(scenario, "current_eez_count_cat", "current"),
         scenario = str_replace(scenario, "RCP85_2050_eez_count_cat", "RCP85_2050"))
```

```{r}
# Plot a bar graph by group with fill as the EEZ count category
taxon_bar_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = eez_count_group_simple, aes(y = fct_rev(redlist_category), fill = fct_rev(eez_count_cat)), position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "",
       y = "",
       x = "proportion",
       fill = "EEZ count") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~scenario)
```

```{r}
group_eez_count_diff <- group_eez_count_threshold %>% 
  mutate(eez_count_diff = RCP85_2050_eez_count - current_eez_count) %>% 
  dplyr::select(redlist_category, aphiaid, current_eez_count,RCP85_2050_eez_count, eez_count_diff)
```

```{r}
taxon_jitter_plot_only <- ggplot() +
  geom_jitter(data = group_eez_count_diff, aes(x = eez_count_diff, y = fct_rev(redlist_category), alpha = 0.6),
   color = "gray10", position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0, jitter.width = .6),) +
  scale_y_discrete() + 
  labs(title = "EEZ subregion counts by IUCN redlst category",
       x = "EEZ subregion count change\n(RCP8.5 2050 - current)",
       y = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
